problem.title: How many clients are you losing because your messages reach no one?
problem.subtitle: Cold email competes in increasingly crowded inboxes. The phone remains a direct alternative — and works better when you know who you are calling and what to say.

items.title: Cold email competes for attention
items.text: Between spam filters, crowded inboxes and messages that sound like templates, getting a reply by email can be difficult.

items.title: Calling is easier when you are prepared
items.text: When someone picks up, you need to know what the company does, how to start and how to respond to a "not interested". Preparation means you do not improvise from scratch.

items.title: Finding companies by hand eats your week
items.text: Google, each company's website, copying data into a spreadsheet. Hours of mechanical work before you've spoken to a single person.

features.title: Everything you need to pick up the phone today
features.subtitle: No tool switching. No learning curve. From your very first search.

items.title: Real companies in your industry and city
items.description: Type "dental clinics in Valencia" and get the name, website, phone number when available and address. Companies that exist, not purchased lists.

items.title: Public business phone numbers when available
items.description: Many local businesses publish a phone number even when they do not publish a useful sales email. OpenSells brings that public contact data into the same prospecting workflow.

items.title: The AI prepares the call for you
items.description: Before you dial you get the brief: what they do, why calling them may make sense, a suggested opening line, three questions and responses to common objections.

items.title: Keep follow-up organised
items.description: After contacting a lead, you can update its status, save notes and create tasks for the next step. Your follow-up stays in the same place.

items.title: AI emails when you'd rather write
items.description: For leads with an email address, AI drafts a personalised message after reading their site. Review it and send it from OpenSells through your connected Gmail account.

items.title: Your data is yours
items.description: On a paid plan, export your leads to CSV whenever you want and take them to your CRM. During the free trial, CSV export is limited to 50 leads per month.

items.q: How long until I see results?
items.a: Your first list can be ready in a few minutes and you can start prospecting the same day. A phone call gives you immediate feedback on whether there is interest; email replies may take longer or never arrive.

Phone numbers often have better coverage among local businesses than useful sales email addresses and let you start a conversation directly. We still include AI email, but recommend using whichever channel best fits each case.

We don't run technical mailbox verification (SMTP or MX). We extract email addresses that companies publish on their own websites, so they are public addresses, but they may be outdated or generic inboxes.

items.q: Is cold calling businesses legal in Spain?
items.a: The rules that apply depend on the type of contact, purpose and specific circumstances. OpenSells works with public business data, but how that data is used for prospecting remains the user's responsibility. This is not legal advice: review your specific case and always respect requests not to be contacted again.

items.q: What if I don't know what to say on the phone?
items.a: That's what the call brief is for. Before you dial you have what the company does, why calling them may make sense, a suggested opener, questions to see whether they are a fit and prepared responses to common objections.

items.q: How is this different from Hunter.io or Apollo?
items.a: Hunter and Apollo are broader data and prospecting platforms. OpenSells aims to be simpler and focused on one workflow: find businesses by industry and city, gather their public data, prepare the conversation and organise follow-up in one place.

Yes, with no lock-in or penalties. Cancel from your dashboard and you will not be charged for the next billing period. The first month is free and no card is required; if you cancel within 7 days of your first charge, you can request a refund of that payment.

items.q: Does it work for any industry?
items.a: It works especially well when selling to businesses with a public presence and visible contact details: repair shops, clinics, consultancies, accountants, hospitality, training or real estate, among others.

items.q: What happens to my data if I cancel?
items.a: Your leads are yours. On a paid plan you can export them to CSV without a limit before cancelling. During the free trial, export is limited to 50 leads per month. We keep your history for 30 days in case you change your mind.
